evidence_kind: Matching PE/PDB static instructions and jump tables; no original-engine execution.

dispatch.name: DrawScreenRelative
dispatch.thing_write: Thing+0x220=true only; no animation own flag or child-chain mutation

location.attached: Valid attached Thing reference -> recursive parent location + attachOffset(+0x200/+0x204)
location.unattached: Thing own location(+0x88/+0x8c), for screen and world Things alike

thing_parallax.formula: Thing own(+0x22c) multiplied by MapThing(+0xf0) when optional map pointer(+0x240) exists
thing_parallax.dynamic_defaults: Thing constructor0x1802daac6 stores own=1;0x1802daadd stores map pointer=null, so map factor=1

render_ownership.effective_screen_flag: Attached Thing+0x220 when attachment pointer exists; otherwise Animation own+0x64
render_ownership.own_flag_independent: Animation own+0x64, not effective screen flag, bypasses GetParallaxAmount in PrepDraw. DrawScreenRelative does not change it.
render_ownership.gui_line_exception: GUIComponentAnimation.SetAnimation creates with null Thing (0x18016aa12 and0x18016ab51) and calls SetUseScreenLocation at0x18016ab91; portable player owner association is not an actual Thing attachment.
render_ownership.detachment: OnAttachedToPreDispose0x18029a280 clears attached pointer and does not copy Thing screen flag into Animation own flag

portable_implementation.backend: ObjectBackend records portable component ownership; ObjectSnapshot.screenSpace records actual Thing rendering flag. DrawScreenRelative does not migrate actors into ScreenAnimationWorld.
portable_implementation.screen_set: Portable presentation explicitly enumerates all registered actor primaries and all action animations, independently of world draw-grid admission; removal followed by the owner flag supplies the native screen set3 rendering route.
explicit_unimplemented: ScenePrimary static and auxiliary screen projection
portable_implementation.screen_destination: ScreenAnimationWorld stores actual Thing own/map parallax independently of screen flag; current producer admits unattached dynamic screen Things only.
